about: Design bench: briefs an agent should handle like a top engineer and designer. Each brief lists the features a good answer has (groups of words; any word in a group matches a feature id or label), whether the brief is complex (the staged workflow must trigger), and what the solid must show. 'exemplar' names the reference design in form/exemplars that the bench builds and checks; briefs without one are scored only on staging until an agent's solution is passed in (bench.py --solutions DIR, one NAME.py per brief id).

briefs.brief: A full-face motorcycle helmet shell with a carbon-like texture, vents and a visor pivot.
A 5:1 planetary gearbox stage with a flanged ring housing and a carrier.
A small clamshell case with a print-in-place hinge and a snap latch.
An ergonomic screwdriver handle with a textured grip and a hex bit socket.
A quick-release tube clamp with a cam lever for a 25.4 mm bar.
A knurled control knob for a 6 mm D-shaft with a pointer.
A vase with spiral ribs and a rolled lip.
A belt idler pulley on a 608 bearing with a tensioner arm.
A cable drag-chain link that snaps to the next one.
An Arca-style camera quick-release plate with a dovetail and a matching jaw.
A lightweight tapered drone arm with a motor mount for 16x19 M3 motors.
A table lamp with a lofted, twisted shade on a weighted base.
An ergonomic computer mouse shell with a thumb rest and textured sides.
A folding phone stand with a hinge and a cable pass-through.
A bayonet lens cap with a grip ring and an embossed logo field.
A GoPro-style three-prong mount on a curved helmet base.
A ratchet wrench handle with a pawl and a 1/4 inch square drive.
An under-desk headphone hook with a soft curved cradle.
A textured bike handlebar grip with an end cap.
A 20 mm spacer, 10 mm long, with a 5.2 mm hole.
